title: The Chariot of Fire
themeTags: not left alone when someone leaves
reflectionQuestion: Elijah went home to God, but Elisha was not left alone -- God gave him all he needed to carry on. I wonder who stays close to you, even when someone you love is far away?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Elijah & Elisha, 2 Kings 2). Fills freed ID 1880. The unforgettable VISUAL (chariot + horses of fire, whirlwind) is the replay hook. WATCH-ITEM: the goodbye kept GENTLE + HOPEFUL -- Elijah does NOT die; God takes him home to heaven; the fiery chariot is 'blazing bright and beautiful, and not frightening at all'. Elisha is 'sad to see his friend go' but knows Elijah is safe/happy with God, and receives Elijah's cloak + the same Spirit to carry on. Room = God takes his friends home / when someone you love goes away, God stays close and gives you what you need. A gentle on-ramp to loss/separation without death-fear. Soft close ('on'/'strong').
